messages:
emily (Support): FYI customer Josh (acct: acme-corp) reports that when they request structured JSON in streaming mode the output sometimes ends with a truncated JSON object — missing the final closing brace. Request id: rwd-req-9a3b2f.

josh (Customer): Repro steps: call /v1/responses with stream=true, schema enforcement enabled. After about ~2-5% of attempts we get an incomplete JSON payload and client fails to parse. Happens on Node.js fetch + SSE client (eventsource).

support-bot: New escalation created: ESC-2026-324. Linked to request rwd-req-9a3b2f.

emily (Support): Thanks Josh. Can you paste a raw captured stream (including chunk boundaries) + headers? Also which region and if any proxy is between you and our API.

josh (Customer): Pasted below — redacted keys. Note the server: nginx reverse proxy in their infra.

--- raw stream capture ---
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

data: {"delta":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"hello\"}]}"}

data: {"delta":" ,\"next\":{\"id\":2,\"text\":\"world\"}"}

data: {"delta":"}"}

--- end capture ---

josh (Customer): The last chunk sometimes never arrives; client receives EOF mid-chunk and parser errors.

maria (ML Eng): Quick read: looks like the server is sending nested-escaped JSON deltas and final join should be valid. If the final chunk is dropped, yes parse fails. Two hypotheses: client-side SSE reconnection/timeouts, or proxy drops idle chunked connections.

kai (SRE): Can we get the gateway logs for rwd-req-9a3b2f? Also what was connection idle timeout and keepalive behavior? If upstream closes connection abruptly we'll see a RESET.

devon (Backend): I pulled the request trace. Upstream (svc-inference-03) reported successful stream writes, with last write at 2026-06-14T21:10:27Z. Proxy (edge-nginx-1) has worker_connections high but chunk buffer size is default. I see a FIN from client side 1s after last write. No 5xx from our side. Trace id: trace-0b7c.

kai (SRE): That matches: our runtime wrote all chunks. If the proxy set "proxy_buffering on;" or has low proxy_read_timeout, it can close mid-stream. We should ask the customer to check their nginx config: proxy_read_timeout and proxy_buffer_size.

emily (Support): Josh — for immediate mitigation can you switch to non-streaming (stream=false) for the endpoint? This will return a single complete JSON body and avoid chunk boundary issues. Also try a client-side buffer that concatenates SSE 'data:' lines until the final finish event.

josh (Customer): Non-streaming works as a workaround but increases latency for tokens. They need streaming for UX. Any server-side fixes we can apply?

maria (ML Eng): We can change how we encode structured output in streaming: instead of emitting escaped JSON fragments that must be stitched, we can emit top-level JSON-lines (jsonl) where each event is a self-contained object, or include an explicit "final":true marker. That reduces sensitivity to dropped trailing bytes. We need product signoff though.

devon (Backend): Short-term: add a periodic keepalive SSE comment (":\n") every 10s to prevent proxy idle timeouts. Also we can set chunked flush boundaries so more predictable. Long-term: support jsonl output mode for structured streaming.

kai (SRE): I'll check if we've had similar alerts — correlating with edge-nginx restart events and customer proxy timeouts. If we can reproduce with a test nginx instance configured like theirs we can confirm.

emily (Support): Action items: 1) Kai to search logs for other customers with truncated streaming events (ETA 2h). 2) Devon to enable keepalive comment and add opt-in response-mode: "json_lines" flag for trials (ETA 3d). 3) Maria to draft prod-safe encoding options and doc note on client stitching (ETA 2d). 4) Josh: try keepalive workaround on your proxy or switch to non-streaming for now.

kai (SRE): Found 4 similar incidents in last 48h where edge->client FIN correlated with proxy_read_timeout=60s. I'll post logs and a sample reproducer.

josh (Customer): Thanks — we'll flip keepalive on our nginx and test. Appreciate the quick triage.

emily (Support): I'll keep ESC-2026-324 open and update when we have the reproducer. :thumbsup:

support-bot: ESC-2026-324 updated: kai (SRE) added gateway logs; devon (Backend) added patch proposal.

emily (Support): Leaving notes for docs team: add a troubleshooting section for "streaming structured output" — common causes: intermediate proxies closing chunked responses, missing client-side stitcher, and server-side escaped-delta encoding risks.

--- end thread ---
